(193)chos dag spu gri las/hūm̐/bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas/bdud 'dul khro bo chen po'i skur ston pa/brjod med spros bral chos

tei:div.tei:p: chos dag spu gri las/ hūm̐/ bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas/ bdud 'dul khro bo chen po'i skur ston pa/ brjod med spros bral chos kyi dbyings nyid las/ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku bzhengs shig dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las grub par mjod/ mi gnas ye shes thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs sku (194)bzhengs shig dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las grub par mjod/ yab yum gnyis su med pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ bdud 'dul khro rgyal yab yum sku bzhengs shig dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las grub par mjod/ ci bgyis las la 'du ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ za bsod mgo brnyan tshogs rnams sku bzhengs (195)shig dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las grub par mjod/ ye shes skar ltar 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ yang sprul sum sprul mang po sku bzhengs shig dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las grub par mjod/ tshad med bzhi ldan dkyil 'khor sgo bzhi nas/ rta gdong sgo skyong rnam bzhi sku (196)bzhengs shig dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las grub par mjod/ ma ltar byams shing sring ltar gdung sems can/ bstan skyong shwa na mched bzhi sku bzhengs shig dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las grub par mjod/ sprul pa mang po 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ bdag nyid chen po 'khor bcas sku bzhengs shig dug gsum (197)sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las grub par mjod/ mtsho bzhi pho brang gtams pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ dam can bswe yi lha mo sku bzhengs shig

dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las grub par mjod/ tsit+ta sgong ltar 'dril ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ skyes bu ging chen bco brgyad sku bzhengs shig dug (198)gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las grub par mjod/ rak+ta mtsho ltar bskyil ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ ma bdun sring bzhi'i tshogs rnams sku bzhengs shig dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las grub par mjod/ gang ga'i rdul ltar spungs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ dbang phyug rtsa brgyad la sogs lhag ma'i gnas/ lang ka dur khrod (199)(200)mkha' 'gro sum cu gnyis/ 'bum phrag yangs pa'i tshogs pa rnams sku bzhengs shig dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las grub par mjod/ ces bskul zhing tshig mtshams so sor gong du bsdogs pa'i ling ro sbyar ba'i khrag skyems gtor ma rnams la dmigs phyed par bstab po/// /
